valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the period FY2024 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2024, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pbFormula: price / (equity per share), equity on FY2024
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 1.02219e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: price / (revenue per share), revenue on FY2026
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 1.02219e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_JSE.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: no positive earnings growth is on file, so P/E over growth cannot be built.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the newest balance sheet on file is FY2024, more than one annual period behind FY2026, so its book value is stale.
